Degree Thesis

Control, Planning, and Formation Identification for a Multi-Rod Planetary Regolith Drilling Robot

Minhui Ye (Advisor: Prof. Tao Zhang)

School of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Guangdong University of Technology, 2026

Develops an integrated control platform, a Petri-net-based cooperative scheduling model, a multi-component coupled drilling-load analytical model, and a physics-guided deep learning method for online formation identification in multi-rod planetary regolith drilling.
